claims.claim: Historical subjects are isolated local clones at the exact authorized commit with a real repository-local .git directory, allowing unchanged relative .git/aios basetemp commands without mutating control state.
Historical REPAIR and recover-primary share the corrected subject boundary while preserving exact candidate, TASK, verification, and remote-lineage semantics.

Historical subject creation is offline and object-exact, rejects missing or mismatched commits, avoids linked-worktree registration, and deterministically removes temporary repositories including read-only Git metadata.
Existing verification-only continuation, Windows verification isolation, evidence continuity, and current control behavior remain unchanged.

Regression coverage exercises historical repair, primary recovery, unchanged relative basetemp execution, exact command persistence, control immutability, cleanup, and missing-object rejection; changes are confined to the three authorized files.
